text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Senior High school diploma or Certificate of Expected Graduation, bearing the stamp of the school. (1) Graduating senior high school students should submit a Certificate of Expected Graduation, issued by their high schools. They should obtain a senior high school diploma before their entry to XMU in September of the academic year. (2) The certificate should be stamped by the school. (3) The originals of the diplomas and certification documents should be made available for verification upon enrolment at XMU. * 2. Academic transcripts for senior high school studies, bearing the stamp of the School. (1) Graduating senior high school students should submit academic transcripts for each year of high school to date. (2) Senior High school graduates should submit a complete set of academic transcripts for senior high school. (3) The results report of their national college matriculation exam or internationally accepted standardized tests, e.g., UEC/A Level/ AP/IB/ SAT/ACT. * 3. English proficiency certificate * 4. Certificate of No Criminal Record The applicants shall submit a valid Certificate of No Criminal Record issued by the local police, usually within 6 months before the date of submission of the application. * 5. One Letter of Recommendation with information of the recommender’s names, employer, work position and contact information, signed by the recommender or with the stamp of the recommending organization. * 6. Personal Statement (minimum 800 words) which should include a self-introduction, educational experience, motivations, study plan and career aspirations. It needs to be written in Chinese for Chinese-medium programs, in English for English-medium programs. * 7. A scanned copy of the first page of the passport (regular passport, valid at least through October 31, 2026) * 8. Physical Examination Record for Inbound Travellers Including chest X ray image, electrocardiogram, laboratory exam results and data sheets of some required items, completed in Chinese or English, with the lower part of the applicant’s photo stamped by the hospital. Physical examination results are valid for 6 months. You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. Financial Support Guarantee Statement and its supporting documents. You can download a template or sample from here . 10. Personal portfolios such as videos and artworks, are REQUIRED for art applicants. * 11. Birth Certificate * 12. Parents’ identity documents 13. Other supporting documents Such as competition awards, merit certificates, community service or special skills certificates, may be submitted in the “Other Supporting Materials” section in the application system as well. 14. Pre-Acceptance Letter (optional). Priority of admission will be given to applicants have acquired the pre-acceptance letter stamped by the college. You can download a template or sample from here . * 15. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
